header: What people write about us when we are not in the room
lead: Posts from the trade forum and from the user group channel, reproduced as they were written and with the writer's permission.
note: Nothing here is embedded. We store the text, so no script from another company loads on this page and the wall survives the forum it came from.

posts.quote_text: Two years in. The thing I did not expect: I stopped keeping a private spreadsheet. That is the whole review.
posts.author: @lager_hanna

posts.quote_text: Support answered on a Saturday about a barcode scanner that was not even theirs. I am still slightly annoyed about how helpful that was.
posts.author: @prohaska_m

posts.quote_text: Small thing that saved my week: the reorder list can be filtered to one supplier and printed as the order. That is it. That is the post.
posts.author: @einkauf_doris

posts.quote_text: Watched a colleague train a new stockman on it in about forty minutes. I have seen tills take longer.
posts.author: @werkstatt_tobi

posts.quote_text: Asked for a CSV of everything at 16:20 and had it at 16:22. No ticket, no sales call, no meeting about our data strategy.
posts.author: @h_wurzer

posts.quote_text: Complaint, for balance: the mobile view of the reports is cramped on a small phone. Everything else I have moaned about here got fixed.
posts.author: @baustoff_nora
